Al-Aqsa University

📍 Gaza City, Gaza
University Gaza Operational

Al-Aqsa University traces its roots to a teacher training college established in 1955 and became a full university in the 1990s. It operates campuses in Gaza City, Khan Yunis, and Deir al-Balah, making it one of the most geographically distributed universities in the Strip. It was particularly noted for its education and arts faculties.
